subject.why: The canteen is instantly recognisable with its round wool-covered body, screw cap, leather strap, and sunflower patch.

category.why: The object floats in the air at a slight angle with no ground beneath it, against a saturated background with centered radiating rays.

clean.why: No text, logos, UI, frames, or characters are present.

framing.why: The object is centrally framed with generous margins on all sides and a bold silhouette.

colour.why: Rich, warm, saturated palette that clearly separates from the sunny yellow ray background.

detail.why: The red fabric cover features visible fuzzy micro-texture and organic wrinkling/creases, violating the rule against micro-detail.

style.why: Instead of the smooth, chunky volumes and clean satin sheen seen in the references, the canteen body has realistic rumples and a noisy surface texture.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (82% of the background); planned yellow

fix: Smooth out the lumpy wrinkles and remove the fuzzy micro-texture on the red cover to match the clean, chunky volumes and satin finish of the references.
